deploy-bot: PLAN summary: +3 to add, ~2 to change, -0 to destroy. Estimated time ~3m. Applying with parallelism=10.
alex.k: quick check — is this touching the LB target group?
priya: Yes, it touches the staging LB health check rule (we're only adding a new path-based rule, no replacement). No planned detach.
jamie: FYI i saw a small diff in security group "staging-app-sg" (cidr_rules ordering) — terraform wants to replace one rule resource due to provider bug (see comment in PR). Expect 1 CHANGE that momentarily re-adds a rule.
morgan: @priya if that causes a momentary connection drop can we do a canary? hold for 2 minutes after apply to watch metrics?
priya: Good idea. I'll monitor and we can pause helm rollout if metrics spike.
